requirements.statement: The module can detect objects in front of it.
requirements.verificationMethod: In indoor test scenarios, confirm the module produces obstacle evidence for objects in front of the robot before a collision would occur.

requirements.statement: The module can react before it hits objects.
requirements.verificationMethod: In indoor test scenarios, confirm the module issues reaction commands in time to prevent collisions with detected objects.

requirements.statement: The module is for a small indoor robot context.
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm the module targets indoor environmental operation assumptions suitable for a small robot.

requirements.statement: The system shall produce timestamped obstacle evidence and status outputs for later analysis.

sourceReference.sourceLocator: reaction behavior benefits from timestamped evidence

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm obstacle evidence records include timestamps and can be exported for later review.

requirements.statement: The system must support required detection distance and field of view for indoor obstacle detection (range/FOV unknown in this phase).

sourceReference.sourceLocator: distance and field of view not specified

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm detection range and field of view requirements for the target indoor robot behavior before selecting an implementation approach.

requirements.statement: The system must meet a required maximum reaction latency so the robot can respond before it hits obstacles (latency unknown in this phase).
requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm required reaction latency so later control timing decisions remain grounded in confirmed needs.

requirements.statement: The system must integrate with the existing robot controller interface so it can issue reaction commands with the expected behavior semantics (robot-controller interface unknown in this phase).

sourceReference.sourceLocator: reaction behavior implies a controller interface

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm what interface behaviors the module must provide to the robot controller for safe reactions.

requirements.statement: The system must assume appropriate indoor environmental constraints and fail-safe safety behavior for uncertain obstacle detection (environment/safety unknown in this phase).

sourceReference.sourceLocator: indoor safety behavior constraints not specified

requirements.verificationMethod: Confirm indoor environmental constraints and the fail-safe behavior expected when obstacle detection is uncertain.

content.requirementSummary: The obstacle-detection module must detect objects in front of the robot, react before collisions, and operate for a small indoor robot context, while confirming open constraints for detection range/FOV, reaction latency, robot-controller interface behavior, and indoor safety/fail-safe assumptions before component selection.

indoor environmental constraints and fail-safe safety expectations
